title: Orfordness Lighthouse
dek: The working lighthouse on Orford Ness whose beam is the leading sceptical account of the lights reported over Rendlesham Forest in December 1980.

prose.label: Role in the case
prose.body: Ian Ridpath and others argued that Halt's flashing light matches the Orfordness character and bearing. The lighthouse is therefore the named alternative to a craft.

image_credit: Historic photographs of the lighthouse; credit the holding archive when attaching.
